ip.description: The public IP address of the device.

status.description: The current status of the device.

location.description: The geographical location of the device (e.g., 'Shiraz, Iran').

last_seen.description: Timestamp of the last time the device was seen online.

last_ping.description: Timestamp of the last manual or automatic ping.

password.description: Password for device access (should be stored securely).

api_key.description: API key for services like Cloudflare.

cloudflare_subdomain.description: Associated Cloudflare subdomain for the device.

local_ips.description: List of local IP ranges (CIDR) managed by the device.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the device was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the device was last updated.

sourceDeviceId.description: The ID of the source device.

destinationDeviceId.description: The ID of the destination device.

intermediateDeviceId.description: The ID of the intermediate device, if any.

status.description: The current status of the tunnel.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the tunnel was created.

VpnConfig.title: VpnConfig
VpnConfig.description: Represents a VPN server configuration on a device.

deviceId.description: The ID of the device this config belongs to.

listenPort.description: The port the VPN service listens on.

allowedIPs.description: CIDR range of allowed IPs for clients.

status.description: The deployment status of the VPN config.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application.

email.description: The email address of the user.

status.description: The status of the user account.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user was last updated.

isVip.description: Whether the user has VIP status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LogAnalysis entity.

deviceId.description: Reference to the Device that generated the log. (Relationship: Device 1:N LogAnalysis)

logMessage.description: The raw log message that was analyzed.

analysisResult.description: A summary of the AI analysis.

problemDetected.description: Whether the AI detected a problem in the logs.

problemDescription.description: A detailed description of the detected problem.

suggestedSolutions.description: AI-suggested solutions for the detected problem.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the analysis was performed.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Represents an audit trail entry for user and system actions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry.

userId.description: The ID of the user who performed the action.

userEmail.description: The email of the user who performed the action.

action.description: A machine-readable string identifying the action (e.g., 'create_device').

details.description: A human-readable description of the action (e.g., 'Created device router-1').

targetId.description: The ID of the entity that was affected (e.g., device ID, user ID).

id.description: Unique identifier for the settings document.

appDomain.description: The primary domain of the application.

logRetention.description: Number of days to retain logs.

pollingInterval.description: Interval in seconds for device polling.

openaiEndpoint.description: The endpoint for the OpenAI-compatible API.

openaiModel.description: The model ID to use for AI features.

openaiToken.description: API token for the AI service.

enabledEvents.description: List of events that trigger notifications.

ApiKey.title: ApiKey
ApiKey.description: Represents a user-generated API key for programmatic access.

keyId.description: A short, non-secret unique identifier for the key.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this key.

scope.description: The permission scope of the key (e.g., 'read', 'write').

expires.description: The expiration timestamp of the key.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the key was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles. The document ID is the Firebase Auth user ID.

/tunnels/{tunnelId}.description: Stores VPN tunnel configurations for all devices.

/vpn_configs/{vpnConfigId}.description: Stores all VPN server configurations for all devices.

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Stores audit trail entries for important user and system actions.

/app_settings/{settingsId}.description: Stores global application settings. Accessible by admins.

/apiKeys/{apiKeyId}.description: Stores hashed API keys for programmatic access. Only accessible by admins.
